name: Fast diffusion models for images and video
gist: These papers speed up diffusion models—generative systems that improve images step by step—through clever attention, sparse computation, or orthogonal tricks to make them practical.
explain: Diffusion models generate images and video by starting with noise and gradually cleaning it up, step by step. The problem is that this takes many steps — often 50, 100, or 1,000 refinement steps to get a good image. Each step is a full pass through the model. This is slow: generating a single image can take seconds or minutes. For video, the problem is exponentially worse because you are diffusing every frame, and the model has to be consistent across frames.

The first approach to speed this up is to skip steps without losing quality. Some researchers find that you can go from 50 steps to 10 steps using special sampling schedules that jump over the steps where the image is not changing much. Others found that merging images across time — computing diffusion across a whole video at once instead of frame-by-frame — can be more efficient because it lets the model see dependencies across frames and avoid redundant computations between similar adjacent frames, though it is harder to keep all frames consistent. A third direction optimizes attention specifically for diffusion: the attention mechanism in diffusion models is expensive, and sparse or approximate attention can cut computation by half or more.

Another angle is orthogonal tricks — clever mathematical structures that let you compute more with fewer operations. Some papers add model predictors that skip ahead, or use ensemble methods where smaller models vote on what the refinement should be. The papers measure image quality, video consistency, and generation speed, finding that even aggressive optimizations often retain most of the quality because diffusion has built-in redundancy — much of the refinement after the first few steps is just polishing, not essential to the output.

papers.title: DIFFSPARSE: ACCELERATING DIFFUSION TRANSFORMERS WITH LEARNED TOKEN SPARSITY
papers.contribution: Achieves 54% computational cost reduction on PixArt-α with 20 steps while surpassing original model's generation metrics; outperforms prior approaches across DiT, PixArt, FLUX, Wan2.1.

papers.title: DPad: Efficient Diffusion Language Models with Suffix Dropout
papers.contribution: Delivers up to 61.4x speedup over vanilla diffusion LLMs while maintaining comparable accuracy on long-sequence inference.

papers.title: DiffuMamba: High-Throughput Diffusion LMs with Mamba Backbone
papers.contribution: Matches Transformer diffusion performance at 1.3B parameters while achieving up to 8.2× higher throughput on long sequences with linear scaling.

papers.title: Dual-View Predictive Diffusion: Lightweight Speech Enhancement via Spectrogram-Image Synergy
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art speech enhancement with only 35% parameters and 40% inference MACs compared to lightweight SOTA model PGUSE.

papers.title: ES-dLLM: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models by Early-Skipping
papers.contribution: Achieves 5.6x to 16.8x speedup over vanilla implementation and up to 1.85x over state-of-the-art caching, delivering 226-308 tokens per second on H200 GPU.

papers.title: Relational Feature Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms prior caching approaches across various DiT models with significantly improved accuracy.

papers.title: Residual Context Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Improves frontier dLLMs by 4-11 percentage points accuracy; on AIME tasks nearly doubles accuracy and achieves 4-5x fewer denoising steps at baseline peak accuracy.

papers.title: SPRINT: Sparse-Dense Residual Fusion for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: SPRINT achieves 9.8x training savings with comparable FID/FDD on ImageNet-1K 256×256, and halves FLOPs at inference.

papers.title: DFSAttn: Dynamic Fine-grained Sparse Attention for Efficient Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2.1× end-to-end speedup while maintaining high generation quality under high sparsity ratios.

papers.title: Efficient Diffusion LLMs via Temporal-Spatial Parallel Decoding and Confidence Extrapolation
papers.contribution: Reduces unnecessary denoising iterations while preserving output quality, composing cleanly with system optimizations like KV caching.

papers.title: Efficient Parallel Samplers for Recurrent-Depth Models and Their Connection to Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 5× speedup on existing 3.5B recurrent-depth transformers without tuning.

papers.title: EigenCache: Rethinking Diffusion Acceleration as Covariance-Optimal Forecasting and Submodular Information Allocation
papers.contribution: Achieves strong speed-fidelity Pareto frontiers across image, video, transformer, U-Net, and LoRA-adapted models with training-free framework.

papers.title: Elastic Diffusion Transformer
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2x speedup with negligible quality loss on image and 3D asset generation tasks.

papers.title: FaPS: A General and Fast Training Method for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3x faster training while maintaining comparable or superior generation quality and improving performance in limited-data settings.

papers.title: Fastcar: Cache Attentive Replay for Fast Auto-Regressive Video Generation on the Edge
papers.contribution: FastCar achieves more than 2.1x decoding speedup with higher energy efficiency on edge devices, and improves sparse attention performance when combined.

papers.title: Let Features Decide Their Own Solvers: Hybrid Feature Caching for Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: HyCa achieves 5.56-6.24x speedup on models like FLUX and HunyuanVideo without retraining, with near-lossless acceleration across diverse domains.

papers.title: Mosaic: Unlocking Over 30$\times$ Context Length for Diffusion LLMs Inference via Global Memory Planning and Dynamic Peak Taming
papers.contribution: Reduces memory peak-to-average ratio by 2.71x and increases maximum inference sequence length by 15.30-32.34x with training-free approach preserving exact outputs.

papers.title: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves 6.28x and 1.64x speedups on SkyReels-V2 and MAGI-1 respectively while preserving generation quality (VBench degradation <1%).

papers.title: PreciseCache: Precise Feature Caching for Efficient and High-fidelity Video Generation
papers.contribution: PreciseCache achieves 2.6× average speedup without noticeable quality loss through precise redundancy detection across various model architectures.

papers.title: RSTR: Reducing SpatioTemporal Redundancy in Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Achieves 50-70% compute savings while maintaining or improving quality, with 57% savings and 15% FID improvement on DiT-XL/2 and 3.43x speedup on Qwen-Image.

papers.title: RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 1.55× speedup on average in linear layers while preserving generation quality of original models.

papers.title: Singular Proxies for Adaptive Caching in Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: The method achieves up to 8× throughput improvement over vanilla models and 2-4× speedup over existing caching baselines.

papers.title: Transform Trained Transformer for Accelerating Native 4K Video Generation
papers.contribution: Accelerates native 4K video generation by more than 10× with +4.29 VQA and +0.08 VTC performance improvements.

papers.title: WeDLM: Reconciling Diffusion Language Models with Standard Causal Attention for Fast Inference
papers.contribution: Delivers speedups approaching 3× on reasoning benchmarks and up to 10× in low-entropy generation while preserving quality.

papers.title: WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching
papers.contribution: Delivers up to 3.7x end-to-end speedups while maintaining 98% rollout quality in resource-constrained scenarios.
